units: Sot. 48ᵇ משחרב … בטלה ש׳ פ׳ וכ׳ when the first Temple was destroyed, the use of p. silk and of white glass was suspended.
Sabb. 20ᵇ שירא … וש׳ פ׳ לחוד silk is different from p’randa silk. [Sachs, Beitr. II, p. 185 refers to late Greek πράνδιοι (πράνδιον fillet, S.), from which he derives French frange, Engl. fringe.]
